events.description: The U.S. Department of Defense awarded Boeing a $20 billion contract to develop the Navy’s next‑generation sixth‑generation strike fighter.

events.title: Trump says AI companies sign voluntary accord on safety controls
events.description: President Trump and leaders of major AI firms signed a voluntary agreement to strengthen safety reviews and self‑regulation of artificial‑intelligence technologies.

events.title: Morocco appoints its first female prime minister
events.description: King Mohammed VI issued a royal decree naming Fatima Zahra El Mansouri as Morocco’s first female prime minister, tasking her with forming a new cabinet.

events.title: Boeing nabs $20B contract for Navy's futuristic fighter
events.description: Boeing wins a $20 billion contract to develop the U.S. Navy's next-generation fighter aircraft.

events.title: Settlers clash with Israeli forces to block Palestinian family’s return home
events.description: Jewish settlers confront Israeli troops while trying to prevent a Palestinian family from returning to their house in the West Bank.

events.title: US imposes sanctions on 13 tied to Iran weapons procurement
events.description: The United States sanctions 13 individuals and entities linked to Iran's weapons procurement network.

events.title: Morocco's king appoints the country's first-ever female prime minister
events.description: King Mohammed VI names Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri, former mayor of Marrakesh, as Morocco's first female prime minister.

events.title: Japan calls on India to fast-track UNICORN naval radar agreement
events.description: Japan urged India to accelerate the internal process for the UNICORN naval radar technology transfer pact signed during the Japanese prime minister's visit.

events.title: UK Police Find Fuel But No Explosives at Fairford Scene
events.description: Counter‑terror police discovered fuel but no explosives at RAF Fairford, a base used by the US for strikes in Iran.

events.title: Ukraine uses unmanned 'zombie cars' packed with explosives to decimate Russian frontline positions for first time
events.description: Ukrainian forces deployed driverless explosive‑laden vehicles against Russian troops, capturing 250 Russian soldiers in the assault.

events.title: Motorcycle patrols swarm Iranian cities, checkpoints rise as regime braces for unrest
events.description: Iran’s IRGC, Basij and police intensified security in Tehran with numerous checkpoints and patrols amid growing student protests over compulsory hijab laws.

events.title: Tankers Are Loading Oil Again From a Vital Saudi Pipeline
events.description: Saudi authorities resumed oil loading on tankers from a key pipeline after it was temporarily shut down following a drone attack.

events.title: Iran says it expects response to cease‑fire plan already rejected by Trump
events.description: Iran warned it will respond after the U.S. rejected its cease‑fire proposal, heightening diplomatic tension.

events.title: Israel’s Gaza air strike kills Hamas commander behind October 7, 2023 attack
events.description: An Israeli air strike in north Gaza killed the head of Hamas’ armed wing, a key figure linked to the Oct 7 attacks.

events.title: Russia's spy agency opens criminal case against Lib Dem councillor in London
events.description: Russia’s security service launched a criminal investigation against a Russian exile living in London, accusing her of involvement with a terrorist organization.

events.title: America's Canadian import restrictions come into force
events.description: The United States imposed new import bans on several Canadian products, escalating trade friction between the two nations.

events.title: Chile's defence minister backs trade between Punta Arenas and the Falklands
events.description: Chile's defence minister supported the development of commercial activity linking the Magallanes region with the Falkland Islands, backing Argentina's sovereignty claim.

events.title: Ex-foreign minister holds talks with China’s top diplomat, economic official
events.description: Japanese ex‑foreign minister met China’s foreign minister Wang Yi, who warned that bilateral relations are in a "severe situation" and need to be normalized again.

events.title: Over 100 Jewish extremist settlers riot near West Bank town, clash with Israeli forces
events.description: Extremist settlers clashed with Israeli Border Police near Jalud, setting fire to property and injuring three officers.

events.title: Spanish fighter jets scrambled with Romania 'alert' as Putin launches huge attack
events.description: Two Spanish F‑18s were dispatched to monitor the situation after Russia launched a major attack on Ukraine, reflecting heightened NATO vigilance.

events.title: Turkish diplomat Güllüoğlu appointed to senior UN posts
events.description: Former Turkish ambassador Mehmet Güllüoğlu was appointed to two senior positions within the United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs.

events.title: US visa clash exposes Sudan’s forgotten war as foreign powers compete for strategic foothold
events.description: Der Sudanese Oberbefehlshaber Abdel Fattah al‑Burhan reagierte trotzig, nachdem die USA ihm das Visum verweigerten, was die Spannungen im langjährigen Konflikt verschärft.

events.title: UAE president discussed bilateral relations with Israel's Netanyahu, state news agency says
events.description: Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed met Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in Cairo to talk about strengthening ties between the United Arab Emirates and Israel.

events.title: Iran says it's up to Trump to choose between war and diplomacy
events.description: Iran warned President Trump that the United States must decide whether to pursue military action or diplomatic engagement with Tehran.

events.title: UN marks 25 Years of Durban Declaration as Guterres calls for stronger global action
events.description: The UN General Assembly held a high‑level meeting in New York to commemorate the Durban Declaration on racism and to urge renewed international commitment.

events.title: Yemen's humanitarian crisis is worsening
events.description: Intensifying fighting between Houthi forces and government troops leaves over 130,000 people displaced and hampers aid delivery.

events.title: 'We have nothing, no safe place, no food': Yemen's humanitarian crisis is worsening
events.description: Der anhaltende Konflikt zwischen Huthi und Regierungstruppen verschärft die humanitäre Lage in Jemen, wo über 130.000 Menschen vertrieben sind.

events.title: Hybrid warfare: The threat of Russia looms over the Mediterranean
events.description: Intelligence reports warn that Russia is preparing hybrid operations across the Mediterranean Sea.

events.title: 5 Men Released On Bail After Arrest Near U.S.-Run Air Base In England, Police Say
events.description: British police arrested five men near RAF Lakenheath on counter‑terrorism charges; they were later released on bail.

events.title: Lebanon PM meets Rubio as Israel talks stall
events.description: Lebanese Prime Minister meets U.S. Senator Marco Rubio in Beirut to discuss stalled U.S.-brokered talks with Israel.

events.title: India poll chief Gyanesh Kumar under pressure over alleged manipulation of electoral rolls
events.description: Opposition parties demand the resignation of India's election chief amid accusations of voter‑list tampering.

events.title: UK police 'investigate Iran link' to alleged bomb threat against base hosting U.S. Air Force
events.description: British counter‑terrorism police are probing a possible Iranian connection to a bomb threat made against RAF Fairford, a base used by US forces.

events.title: Saudi foreign minister arrives in Washington for talks with Rubio
events.description: Saudi Foreign Minister Prince Faisal bin Farhan met US Secretary of State Marco Rubio in Washington to discuss bilateral issues.

events.title: Trump Asked China's President If He Wants To Buy U.S. Arms, Ambassador Says
events.description: U.S. ambassador to China reports that former President Donald Trump offered President Xi Jinping the opportunity to purchase American weapons.

events.title: Israel strips Dutch diplomats of status in West Bank
events.description: In retaliation to Dutch sanctions on settlement products, Israel's foreign ministry revoked the diplomatic status of Dutch embassy staff operating in the occupied West Bank.

events.title: Supersonic Russian jets trigger joint scramble by NATO allies amid Putin 'clowns' jab
events.description: Finnish F/A‑18 Hornets and Swedish Gripens were scrambled for the first time together to intercept Russian military jets over the Gulf of Finland.

events.title: Israel's Netanyahu visited Abu Dhabi on Sunday, Israeli official says
events.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu met UAE President Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed Al Nahyan in Abu Dhabi, marking another step in the recent normalization process between the two countries.

events.title: U.K. police arrest five for preparing ‘terrorist act’ near air base
events.description: Five men were arrested on suspicion of preparing a terrorist act near the RAF base, prompting evacuation of nearby households.

events.title: Vucic announces resignation as Serbian president
events.description: President Aleksandar Vucic stepped down, triggering snap parliamentary elections scheduled for October 25.

events.title: Iran's foreign minister says Tehran ready for 'doomsday' war with U.S., but leaves diplomacy on the table
events.description: Iranian FM warned of a possible large‑scale conflict with the United States while stating that diplomatic channels remain open.

events.title: Bomb squad searching vans near U.S. air base in Britain as five men arrested on terror charge
events.description: British authorities deployed a bomb squad to inspect vehicles near a U.S. air base after the arrest of five suspects on terrorism charges.

events.title: South Korea voices regret over Ukraine denial of pact on North Korean PoWs
events.description: Seoul expressed strong regret over Ukraine's denial of an agreement not to disclose the transfer of two North Korean prisoners of war.

events.title: Iran captures another US spy drone in Hormuz (VIDEO) — Iran’s IRGC says it captured a US Remus 600 underwater drone allegedly spying in the Strait of Hormuz
events.description: Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps announced the seizure of a U.S. Remus‑600 underwater surveillance drone in the strategic Strait of Hormuz.

events.title: Allarme esplosivi vicino a base della Raf, in campo antiterrorismo Gb
events.description: Explosive devices were discovered near a RAF base in the United Kingdom, prompting a major security response.

events.title: Israeli minister Bezalel Smotrich calls for war in occupied West Bank
events.description: The minister publicly urges a war‑like approach in the occupied West Bank, heightening political tension.

events.title: Afghanistan says 28 fighters killed after crossing from Pakistan
events.description: Afghan defence forces report killing 28 insurgents and wounding 32 in Nuristan province.

events.title: Palestinian death toll in Gaza war crosses 74,000: Health Ministry
events.description: The Gaza health ministry reports over 74,000 war‑related deaths, marking a humanitarian crisis of massive scale.

events.title: Iranian minister says only negotiation can end conflict after Trump rejects Hormuz deal
events.description: Iran's foreign minister emphasized that negotiations are the sole path to resolve tensions following the U.S. president's rejection of a Hormuz agreement.

events.title: Iran Says Won’t Soften Demands After Trump Rejects Hormuz Offer
events.description: Iran reaffirmed its seven‑day proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, rejecting the U.S. president’s mixed signals and warning of continued pressure on shipping.

events.title: Kiev taking 'exhaustive measures' to hinder reconstruction in DPR — Pushilin
events.description: DPR leader Denis Pushilin says Ukrainian forces are obstructing the installation of utilities and life‑support systems in liberated areas.

events.title: Recreational Aerial Craft Become Weapons in Myanmar’s War
events.description: Myanmar’s military is increasingly using motorized paragliders and gyrocopters to bomb rebel‑held towns and villages.

events.title: Hours Before Flight, 2 US Couples Killed In Blast In Athens Building
events.description: A bomb blast in the Plaka district of Athens killed two American tourists just before their scheduled flight.
